# Resource status — 2027 teaching draft · edition 0.49

Current teaching target: **2027**. Edition metadata and source-list check: **30 October 2026**. This is an independent classroom draft, not an SCSA-approved or fully verified alignment.

2026 remains the technical foundation, with the applicable 2027 revisions. Valid 2026 chapter citations are retained and explained in the [syllabus comparison](syllabus-basis.md).

## Current syllabus basis

- Year 11 / Units 1–2: SCSA Computer Science ATAR syllabus **for teaching from 2026**, the Year 11 version currently listed for use. This does not mean there is a separately published Year 11 2027 syllabus.
- Year 12 / Units 3–4: SCSA Computer Science ATAR syllabus **for teaching from 2027**. The earlier Year 12 2026 syllabus is not the current target basis.
- [Official course page](https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/syllabus-and-support-materials/technologies/computer-science), checked 30 October 2026, is the source of document links and listing dates. Official documents remain the authority.
- [Current item-level source/evidence matrix](curriculum/) separates source locators, candidate explanations/examples/independent tasks, formative questions, lesson candidates and explicit review/assessment gaps.

## What the edition label means

The public book contains 50 draft chapters across four units, using Python and SQLite. The new matrix indexes 648 parent/nested unit-content bullets (519 leaf rows), not 648 independently verified outcomes. Every row awaits exact item-level review and school-issued assessment mapping. A suggested link or automated test is not evidence of student achievement or independent curriculum approval. Historical grouped audits retain their own dates, edition labels and limitations.

The edition date is not a new authoring/review date for every chapter, slide, download or historical audit. A02 preparation resources and the A03 trial/moderation pack are available; actual school-machine/learner readiness, full-core timing and independent moderation remain pending. Replacement/remaining slides and complete secure papers remain separate work.

## Planning and school adoption

The plan provides 64 lessons per semester in 16 teaching weeks, with Weeks 17–18 blocked for examinations. At 55 minutes, 64 lessons provide 58 h 40 min; at 50 minutes, 53 h 20 min before exam blocks. Check actual contact hours, losses and the school calendar against the syllabus rather than assuming lesson counts establish coverage. Project workshops remain 10/14/12/16 in Units 1/2/3/4.

The library proposes eight tasks per year and retains the current syllabus category percentages. School-adopted assessment outlines, issued task items and final keys have not been supplied or approved through this site. The WACE Manual page currently lists the 2026 edition; recheck for the applicable 2027 manual before issue. Older SCSA sample outlines are reference examples, not the school’s adopted 2027 documents. Use [the school review record](curriculum/school-review.md).

## Public access and provenance

No account is needed. This static textbook supplies public worksheets, questions, explained answers and teacher resources; teacher answers are not access-protected. It does not collect student submissions or approve school assessment decisions. Exam practice uses local self-marking/browser storage only.

Original content CC BY 4.0; code MIT. [Licence scope](licence.html). Official/third-party resources retain their own terms and are not relicensed by the matrix. No SCSA or Department endorsement is implied.

The prior status record is preserved at [edition 0.48, assembled 14 October/reviewed 15 October 2026](audits/resource-edition-0.48-2026-10-15.md).
